references.matching_note: The Kaplansky variant is a special case of the independently indexed direct-sum dévissage.
All modules and quotients are modules over the common ring R.

references.context: Module theory: quotient module of consecutive stages of an ordinal-indexed filtration
references.reason: The quotient construction and its induced R-action should be compared to quotient-module occurrences.

references.context: Module theory: module generated by at most countably many elements
references.reason: This is not the same as a finitely generated module; do not substitute the existing finite-generation definition.

review_rationale: Reviewed Kaplansky dévissage as a specialized direct-sum filtration with countably generated successive quotient modules, not finite generation.
